entries.title: Psalms 48:1
segments: ¶<<A Song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.>> Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised In the city of our God, [In] His holy mountain.

entries.title: Psalms 48:2
segments: Beautiful in elevation, The joy of the whole earth, [Is] Mount Zion [on] the sides of the north, The city of the great King.

entries.title: Psalms 48:3
segments: God [is] in her palaces; He is known as her refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 48:4
segments: For behold, the kings assembled, They passed by together.

entries.title: Psalms 48:5
segments: They saw [it, and] so they marveled; They were troubled, they hastened away.

entries.title: Psalms 48:6
segments: Fear took hold of them there, [And] pain, as of a woman in birth pangs,

entries.title: Psalms 48:7
segments: [As when] You break the ships of Tarshish With an east wind.

entries.title: Psalms 48:8
segments: ¶As we have heard, So we have seen In the city of the LORD of hosts, In the city of our God: God will establish it forever. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 48:9
segments: We have thought, O God, on Your lovingkindness, In the midst of Your temple.

entries.title: Psalms 48:10
segments: According to Your name, O God, So [is] Your praise to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 48:11
segments: Let Mount Zion rejoice, Let the daughters of Judah be glad, Because of Your judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 48:12
segments: Walk about Zion, And go all around her. Count her towers;

entries.title: Psalms 48:13
segments: Mark well her bulwarks; Consider her palaces; That you may tell [it] to the generation following.

entries.title: Psalms 48:14
segments: For this [is] God, Our God forever and ever; He will be our guide [Even] to death.
